name: Rin
source: A horned girl living in the forest with the shrine of the evil god. She is a descendant of the “Sealing Clan” and waits alone to seal the evil god. Because of her horns, villagers fear her and think she serves the evil god. Quiet, she continues to watch over the village from afar.
